propositions: acli_graph.py hand-rolls identical cursor-pagination loops three times without runaway-token guards, allowing servers that repeat the same nextPageToken to spin forever (cabc failure mode)
a shared cursor iterator with runaway guard is needed: raises RunawayPaginationError when the same non-null token appears twice consecutively, terminating on isLast:true or absent token

each of the three maps must wrap RunawayPaginationError in an explicit re-raise handler ahead of their fail-open catch-all to prevent silent partial-map degradation and preserve data-integrity signaling
all three acli_graph pagination loops must be refactored to route exclusively through the new shared iterator, with structural tests pinning the wiring and eliminating hand-rolled loops
ordinary transport faults continue to degrade open (returning partial dicts) while RunawayPaginationError escapes the fail-open handlers as a loud integrity failure
offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages, jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) are out of scope and remain untouched with their held-out suites passing
